name: Shemariah
overview: Shemariah was a male figure who came to the aid of David at Ziklag, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 12:5. He is noted for joining David during a critical time, supporting him in his leadership. Scripture highlights his involvement in David's band at Ziklag without specifying his tribal affiliation.
namesAndTitles: The name Shemariah means "YHWH guards, preserves," reflecting a divine protection theme common in Hebrew names. This proper name, mentioned in 1 Chronicles 12:5, underscores the trustworthiness and care attributed to the Lord in the life of this individual.
familyAndRelationships: Shemariah is explicitly identified as a descendant of Benjamin according to 1 Chronicles 12:5. Beyond this tribal lineage, Scripture does not provide further familial details about him.
scriptureSignificance: Shemariah's significance lies in his support of David during a formative period when David was establishing his kingship. By coming to David at Ziklag, he represents the faithful followers who recognized and aided God's anointed king. His inclusion in the narrative emphasizes the gathering of diverse supporters around David, affirming God's providential care through loyal individuals like Shemariah.
